aggregate: retention orphan purge and terminal summaries

tables.name: communication_retention
columns: state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in RETAINED,ORPHAN_PENDING_PURGE,PURGED
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK revision>=1

tables.name: communication_protection_holds
columns: communication_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communications
hold_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in PROPOSAL,CORRECTION,COLLISION_REVIEW,PROTECTED_EXPORT,OTHER_GOVERNED
state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in ACTIVE,CLOSED

tables.name: communication_retention_events
columns: communication_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communications

tables.name: communication_terminal_summaries
columns: target_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in SERVICE_REQUEST,RFC
last_interaction_known INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK in 0,1
last_direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in RECEIVED,SENT,MIXED,UNKNOWN
coverage_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in COMPLETE,PARTIAL,UNKNOWN

rules: protected dependency set is active communication links plus active holds; retention transitions use current indexed reads inside UoW
due purge physically removes subject/body/participant/attachment chunks/search material but preserves communication identity, link/proposal/retention event history and terminal summaries
existing backups and exported artifacts are outside purge mutation scope
